author: Bobby Grayson
description: Fix for the next round: write a short ORIENTATION.md (one page: what exists, where, the five invariants an agent must respect) and point builders at it instead of the full README plus readiness report; have them read the large files only when their piece needs them. Also worth having builders commit a skeleton early so an interruption does not lose all context.
title: Round 9 stalled and restarted: the three largest agent transcripts all end in '[Request interrupted by user]', and 10 transcripts exist for a 4-builder round. Fresh agents are re-reading README, docs/readiness.md and to_lean.exs from scratch, so ~3 hours produced no commits. Root cause of the expense: the COMMON prompt makes every agent onboard through a repo that has grown to a 900-line README, an 1800-line readiness report and a 2000-line translator, and that cost is paid again on every restart
